# LaplandStays

> Where to stay in Lapland: glass igloos, aurora cabins and village hotels across Levi, Ylläs, Saariselkä and Inari.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://laplandstays.com/): Accommodation guide for Finnish Lapland
- [Property types](https://laplandstays.com/property-types/): Glass igloos, cabins, hotels and apartments compared
- [Cabins](https://laplandstays.com/cabins/): Cabin stays across Finnish Lapland
- [When to go](https://laplandstays.com/when-to-go/): Seasons and booking timing in Lapland
- [Transport](https://laplandstays.com/transport/): Getting to and around Lapland accommodation
- [Levi](https://laplandstays.com/destinations/levi/): Where to stay in Levi
- [Ylläs](https://laplandstays.com/destinations/yllas/): Where to stay in Ylläs
- [Saariselkä](https://laplandstays.com/destinations/saariselka/): Where to stay in Saariselkä
- [Inari](https://laplandstays.com/destinations/inari/): Where to stay in Inari
- [Rovaniemi](https://laplandstays.com/destinations/rovaniemi/): Where to stay in Rovaniemi
